changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The copy retention reads the unerased tool results that can copy anyone's data, by workspace and write time.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversation_entry_unredacted_copies ON public.conversation_entry (workspace_id, created_at, id) WHERE redacted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'TOOL_RESULT' AND payload -> 'message' ->> 'toolName' IN ('read', 'bash', 'load_context', 'fetch_context')

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The owner function also names the due copying tool results of one workspace, so the copy retention crosses owners only through it. It stays one of the narrow definer functions: it returns only kind, key, workspace, account and due time.
